程序包 org.bukkit.event.block

package org.bukkit.event.block
Events relating to when a block is changed or interacts with the world. 与方块被更改或与世界交互相关的事件。
  • 相关程序包
    程序包
    说明
    org.bukkit.event
    Classes dedicated to handling triggered code executions.
  • 类
    说明
    Action
     
    BlockBreakEvent
    Called when a block is broken by a player.
    BlockBurnEvent
    Called when a block is destroyed as a result of being burnt by fire.
    BlockCanBuildEvent
    Called when we try to place a block, to see if we can build it here or not.
    BlockDamageEvent
    Called when a block is damaged by a player.
    BlockDispenseEvent
    Called when an item is dispensed from a block.
    BlockEvent
    Represents a block related event.
    BlockExpEvent
    An event that's called when a block yields experience.
    BlockExplodeEvent
    Called when a block explodes 当方块爆炸时调用
    BlockFadeEvent
    Called when a block fades, melts or disappears based on world conditions 当方块基于世界条件而消褪、融化或消失时调用
    BlockFormEvent
    Called when a block is formed or spreads based on world conditions.
    BlockFromToEvent
    Represents events with a source block and a destination block, currently only applies to liquid (lava and water) and teleporting dragon eggs.
    BlockGrowEvent
    Called when a block grows naturally in the world.
    BlockIgniteEvent
    Called when a block is ignited.
    BlockIgniteEvent.IgniteCause
    An enum to specify the cause of the ignite 用于指定点燃原因的枚举
    BlockMultiPlaceEvent
    Fired when a single block placement action of a player triggers the creation of multiple blocks(e.g. placing a bed block).
    BlockPhysicsEvent
    Thrown when a block physics check is called 当方块物理检查被调用时抛出
    BlockPistonEvent
    Called when a piston block is triggered 当活塞方块被触发时调用
    BlockPistonExtendEvent
    Called when a piston extends 当活塞伸出时调用
    BlockPistonRetractEvent
    Called when a piston retracts 当活塞收回时调用
    BlockPlaceEvent
    Called when a block is placed by a player.
    BlockRedstoneEvent
    Called when a redstone current changes 当红石电流变化时调用
    BlockSpreadEvent
    Called when a block spreads based on world conditions.
    EntityBlockFormEvent
    Called when a block is formed by entities.
    LeavesDecayEvent
    Called when leaves are decaying naturally.
    NotePlayEvent
    Called when a note block is being played through player interaction or a redstone current.
    SignChangeEvent
    Called when a sign is changed by a player.
